title: Composing like cycles is decided on the tops
subject: Which circuits a law that composes like cycles keeps when values are read modulo the tops
conclusion: In every law whose circuits compose like cycles, each system has exactly the circuits of its image modulo the tops, because each variable and its blurred copy are parallel elements; ties become bijections between tops, and every reflexive pp-definable relation lies below its range's top. The earlier conjecture that such laws are Mal'tsev on all their tops fails for disjoint unions, and holds in every sampled law when restricted to the ranges of knot variables.
